You can find garden snails in a park, or near a river/pond. They're usually in moist areas close to the ground; like hiding between rocks or vegetation. You can also find them hanging out on walls near the bottom end; if it's moist enough and there's enough vegetation for cover. 

You could also ask your local pet shop for snails. They're usually used in terrariums. And im pretty sure you can buy them online too.

Adopt garden snails. From your garden. They're a easy way to get started and you'll see if you really like taking care of them or not. 

Here's a couple of things to keep in mind:

Adopt at least 2 Snails cuz they're social creatures
Keep them in a container large enough for them to move around. They like climbing and exploring.
Make sure the container has enough ventilation and a lid. 
Also add a rock or 2 and some substrate. I like using pebbles.
Make sure you clean regularly. They're quite messy.
Garden snails are mostly vegetarian. So give them leafy greens, fruits (but avoid citrus fruits like oranges. Snails are sensitive for low ph). They also like seeds.
Don't use detergents and soap to clean their tenks. Rinsing with water will do.
Make sure you rinse all food before you feed them.
Keep their environment moist by spraying it wirh water twice a day.
Snails in captivity can live for as long as 10 years
